q.g: In this quest you have to stash the 4 specified items on the scaffolding of the industrial plant on Customs. After accepting the quest you will be sent a set of the required items via in-game mail. It is possible to completely disassemble the DVL-10 rifle since it doesn't need to be functional to be stashed. Note: If you have a DVL-10 equipped as primary or secondary weapon, it will be used up as first for the stashing.

sh.c: SpecterDR scope spot: 2nd floor at the crates in the far corner
DVL-10 magazine spot: 3rd floor in the broken crate
Ammo pack spot: 4th floor at the stacked crates next to the stairs
DVL-10 rifle spot: 4th floor at the crates in the far corner
